survey: A spiral topiary bush made of four stacked tiers that wind upward and get smaller toward a rounded top. It sits inside a low, round stone planter ring with dark soil, on a lawn. A paved path curves around behind it, and a straight hedge and blue sky fill the background. The camera is a little above the planter and looks slightly down. The planter ring is a moderately open ellipse, which fits the angle of the lawn and the curving path behind. The tiers wind around one vertical axis without leaning, and their lower edges curve gently to match a slightly raised view. The bush fills the ring and rests on the soil. Its cast shadow lies flat on the grass to the right. The hedge runs level, and its top line is consistent with the ground plane. Every part agrees on one viewpoint, and none of the problems shown in the examples appear here.
